text.text_excerpt: Came here as a tourist with a local friend of mine. Had a regular burger (not a stuffed one) and it was HUGE and delicious. Good value too. The onion rings were good as well. The service was not great, but to be fair it was a Friday night and the place was packed - I would have liked a water refill at some point.

Stuffed burgers. Sounds weird but tastes so good. I have eaten here twice and each experience has been very good. I have ordered the Turkey Dirty Bird and a beef burger stuffed with bacon and cheddar cheese. (The Atlanta Falcons a/k/a "dirty birds"). This gave whole new meaning to tearing up this sandwich. Each time I ordered sweet potato fries which were very good. I also had a chance to taste the onion rings and they were VERY good. The onion rings will be on my bucket list for next time. The cost of two burgers, two non alcoholic beverages and two side items were approximately $27 before gratuity. Not bad for a nice dine in gourmet burger. Definitely worth a visit. This was one very good Burger Joint! I went here not only because it is within walking distance of where I live but also the many positive things I heard about this place. First things first I need to talk about the Customer service. The waiter I had was very friendly and helpful. He gave me quiet a few suggestions on what to try. That and he explained how they make their burgers which was very interesting to say the least. I chose the Juicy 9th ward burger. What I like about the burger is the fact the ingredients are put inside the meat. A rather new concept for me I might add. Still though the patty was bursting with flavor and nice and juicy!
